servers.description: List every game server with its current state
servers.notes: 🟢 running, ⚪ stopped, ❓ no answer from the panel (server record disabled or the daemon is not reporting). Use `/status <server>` for one server in detail.

status.description: Show one server in detail: state, players, RCON support
status.notes: One server in detail: state, player count, who is online and whether RCON works for that game. For the whole list use `/servers`.

players.description: List the players online right now (via RCON)
players.notes: If the server is stopped it answers "RCON unavailable: the server is stopped" instead of an error; same if the game cannot list players (like some modded setups).

start.notes: Shows a progress embed until the panel reports the server as running. A big modded Minecraft server takes 1-2 minutes to be ready; if it takes longer the embed tells you to check the panel.

stop.description: Stop a game server (asks for confirmation when players are online)
stop.notes: If somebody is playing, the bot shows the online players and waits for a Confirm/Cancel button (60 seconds) before stopping. Use it as a "save everyone first" guard, or `/rcon mc-survival say server restarts in 1 min` before.

restart.description: Restart a game server (asks for confirmation when players are online)
restart.notes: Same confirmation as `/stop`. The embed follows the process until it comes back up (a modded Minecraft server can take 1-2 minutes).

rcon.description: Send a raw RCON command to a server (say, whitelist list, ...)
rcon.notes: Anything the server console accepts, with your own risk: it is not validated. Line breaks and ";" are rejected on purpose. Very long output is cut at 1800 characters.

feed.description: Subscribe or unsubscribe this channel to a server join/leave feed
feed.notes: It applies to the channel where you run it, not to the whole server. New subscriptions start silent: the next message comes with the next real join or leave, not with the people already inside.

options.state: Turn the feed on (this channel) or off

autostop.description: Stop a server automatically after N hours without players
autostop.notes: The clock only counts while the server is up with 0 players; if it is off, or the panel cannot tell, the clock resets. Anyone joining resets it, and 10 minutes of grace apply after /start, /stop or /restart. Operators only.

options.hours: Hours without players before stopping (0 = turn it off)
options.warn: Minutes of warning in the feed before stopping (0 = no warning)

help.description: How to use the bot: every command, examples and tips
help.notes: The command list is generated from the live commands, so it is always up to date.

options.command: Get details and examples for one specific command

language.description: Show or change the language the bot writes in, in this Discord
language.notes: It changes what the bot writes (embeds, notices, help), not the commands themselves: `/start` is still `/start`. `locale:auto` drops your choice and goes back to the configured language. Operators only.

options.locale: Language tag, e.g. es-MX (or "auto" to go back)

help.title: GameAP bot — help
help.intro: I control the game servers of your GameAP panel and post who joins and leaves.
help.tip: **Tip:** every `<server>` accepts the alias (e.g. `mc-survival`) or the numeric id.
help.detailHint: Type `/help command:start` (or any other command) for details and examples.

feed.title: 📣 Join/leave feed
feed.body:
A watcher checks the player list every ~20 s and posts "joined"/"left" in the feed channel.
`/feed <server> off` silences it **in the channel where you run the command**; `/feed <server> on` brings it back.
If a server is stopped, nothing is announced (no fake "everyone left" bursts).
